ledger.note_internal: NPCI: August-2026 value ₹29,82,355.95 Cr = ₹29.82 lakh crore. Confirmed correct; PIB documents carry only July (₹29.88 lakh crore), which is NOT this figure.
162 Vande Bharat Chair Car services plus 2 Vande Bharat Sleeper services = 164. Same total as the Year End Review of 26 Dec 2025.

upi.note: UPI transaction volume in August of each year, billions, from NPCI's UPI product statistics (monthly table), each rounded to two decimals from the millions NPCI publishes. Corrected 13 Sep 2026: 2025 was 19.63, which is SEPTEMBER 2025 (1,963 crore); August 2025 is 20,008.31 Mn. 2021 and 2023 were mis-rounded (3,555.55 Mn -> 3.56; 10,586.02 Mn -> 10.59).

highways.note: Kilometres. National highway network: 91,287 km (March 2014) and 1,46,572 km (Feb 2026), Rajya Sabha Q588. Expressways = operational access-controlled National High-Speed Corridors / expressways: 93 km (2014) and 3,644 km as of Feb 2026, Lok Sabha Q6318 (2 Apr 2026) and Rajya Sabha Q4244 (1 Apr 2026). Corrected 13 Sep 2026 from 3,052 km, which is the December 2025 figure (PIB Year End Review) wrongly labelled Feb 2026.

thenNow.quote: The length of operational access-controlled National High-Speed Corridors (HSCs) / expressways has increased from 93 km in 2014 to 3,644 km as of February 2026.
thenNow.note: MoRTH, Lok Sabha Unstarred Q6318, 2 Apr 2026. National corridors only; the Economic Survey's 5,364 km adds State HSCs and must not be mixed with the 93 km national baseline.

thenNow.quote: Major ports' cargo handling capacity nearly doubled from 873 MMTPA in 2014 to 1,728 MMTPA in 2026
thenNow.note: Both endpoints from one PIB factsheet (12 Aug 2026). Corrected from 1,726, which matched no source. MoPSW's own Annual Report 2025-26 uses a different series — 800.52 MT for 2013-14 and 1,717.96 MT provisional to Dec 2025 — so do not mix its endpoints with this one.

thenNow.quote: The number of operational airports increased from 74 in 2014 to 165 as of 15th July 2026.
thenNow.note: PIB backgrounder "Modified UDAN: Strengthening India's Regional Aviation Network", 17 July 2026, page 1. The document says "operational airports" and gives no breakdown, so do not describe the 165 as including heliports or water aerodromes — that wording belongs to a different, smaller UDAN-network count (95) in the same document. Corroborated by the PIB factsheet of 12 Aug 2026: "Operational airports increased from 74 in 2014 to 165 in July 2026."

thenNow.quote: Metro network expanded from 248 km in 2014 to over 1,155 km in 2026.
thenNow.note: PIB factsheet "India's Infrastructure Transformation: From Connectivity to Capacity", 12 Aug 2026. The same section adds that cities with metro connectivity rose from 5 to 26. Definition caveat: MoHUA's recent totals include the 55 km Delhi-Meerut RRTS (Namo Bharat), while the 2014 baseline is metro only because RRTS did not exist then. MoHUA's Annual Report 2025-26 gives about 1,096 km as on 15 Jan 2026 on the same basis.
